# `%`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
expr1 % expr2, or mod(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns the remainder after `expr1`/`expr2`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT 2 % 1.8;
```

Result:

```text
0.2
```

```sql
SELECT MOD(2, 1.8);
```

Result:

```text
0.2
```
